row_preservation: Each original source row is retained verbatim in its original category basename across chinese/ and chinese/phrase/. All readings move together.
compilation: Chinese compilation reads both directories. A basename of base.csv retains base priority; metadata-listed imported basenames retain their upstream tier. English discovery is unchanged.
limitations: This is not exhaustive linguistic annotation. Independent HanLP observations and curated categories protect known words/names/terms; they are lexical guards, not proof of wordhood. shici.csv is moved as a complete source collection, including its short forms and titles.
